name: agentic-sdlc-evaluation

# Agentic Sdlc Evaluation
Pick 10-20 representative tasks and record human-only baseline. Test task completion, reviewer acceptance, escaped defects, rework, cycle time, cost, token consumption, security incidents and human interventions. Require isolated branches, policy-approved tools, human PR review and deterministic tests. Report comparisons, caveats and a go/no-go decision.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
